pins.name: GPIO2
pins.label: GPIO2
pins.notes:
PIN_CARD_DETECT — onboard SD card connector's card-presence-detect switch (Carrier XL hardware; see board-level note). digital_output/pwm_output dropped: it's a mechanical switch to GND, so driving this pin as an output could short against the switch when a card is inserted. digital_input retained since reading card presence is a genuine, safe, useful operation. Former PIN_WIRE1_SDA alias on this same GPIO removed from pins_arduino.h as an unused/vestigial default copied from the smaller Stamp sibling (see bug-fix note above).
Check if available on board

pins.name: D3
pins.label: GPIO3 (Led active low)
pins.notes: PIN_LED / LED_USR — onboard user LED on the Carrier XL breakout (D2, red, Device:D_Small) that this Stamp XL module plugs/solders into. Confirmed via the Carrier XL's own official KiCad schematic (github.com/solderparty/rp2xxx_stamp_carrier_xl_hw), same schematic and same finding as the RP2350A Stamp sibling: GPIO-row/alt-name pairing places "LED_USR" at the same row as "GPIO3"; net-trace of the LED circuit (+3.3V -> R10 1K -> D2 anode -> D2 cathode -> JP2 bridged jumper -> GPIO3) confirms active-low. digital_input dropped per this repo's established led_high/led_low precedent; pwm_output kept since arduino-pico's analogWrite() works on any RP2350 GPIO. Former PIN_WIRE1_SCL alias on this same GPIO removed from pins_arduino.h (see bug-fix note above). Not confirmed present on the bare Stamp XL module by itself (its own KiCad schematic shows no LED component on this net) — see board-level CAVEAT.

pins.name: D6
pins.label: GPIO6 (Button)
pins.notes: BTN_USR1 — onboard user pushbutton on the Carrier XL breakout (SW4, Switch:SW_SPST, TS-3025-A-A-B), in the same momentary-to-GND switch ladder as the board's own RESET (SW1) and BOOTSEL (SW2) buttons. Not aliased in this board's pins_arduino.h — added directly as a chipGpios entry, matching this repo's adafruit_itsybitsy GPIO13 BOOT-button precedent. Confirmed via the same Carrier XL KiCad schematic GPIO-row/alt-name pairing method as GPIO3 above. Active-low with the RP2350's internal pull-up assumed by convention — not independently confirmed via a devicetree/firmware source. Full digital_input/digital_output/pwm_output capability retained (ordinary GPIO wired to a switch to GND). Not confirmed present on the bare Stamp XL module by itself — see board-level CAVEAT.

pins.notes:

Not general-purpose; this board's own pins_arduino.h deliberately omits a D12 alias for this GPIO (unlike the RP2350A Stamp sibling, which has no DVI connector and exposes D12 normally).
